scope: Isolated candidate-math diagnosis; no product source edits.

inputs.ordering: Each original input followed by exactly the supplemental words consumed in the source-oracle 100000-output run.

initial_diagnosis.interpretation: Math is about 5.17% of the prior complete 100000-output wall time. This is an isolated, separate-run estimate, not simultaneous attribution; cache/loader optimization may change the fraction.

constants_only_smoke.description: Store Q(south) and Q(north)-Q(south) once per validated bounds; preserve the exact target expression, 32+32 bit split and all 52 bisections.
constants_only_smoke.limitations: Single smoke only. Initial diagnostic and comparison harness use different result sinks, so no stable speedup is claimed. No adoption proposed; separate fixed-six/extreme verification was not expanded after the parent stopped this branch.

prefix_and_unroll_experiments.status: Draft copies generated but never benchmarked or adopted. Parent stopped this direction after the 5.17% cost diagnosis. No claims of performance or completed validation.

decision: Do not integrate math metadata/prefix changes. Focus on SHA validation and page-cache/loading costs with larger measured contributions.
followup: sha/measurements.json contains the adopted-for-integration recommendation for a standard 64-word SHA schedule.
